note: Patients with PLAA variants typically present postnatally at 2-4 months with progressive microcephaly and leukoencephalopathy rather than prenatal onset.

evidence.text: Seven patients presenting at ages 2 to 4 months exhibited progressive microcephaly, spastic quadriparesis, and global developmental delay, defining a unique leukoencephalopathy linked to PLAA.

source.title: Phospholipase A2-activating protein is associated with a novel form of leukoencephalopathy
source.quote: Herein, we have identified a unique form of leukoencephalopathy in seven patients presenting at ages 2 to 4 months with progressive microcephaly, spastic quadriparesis, and global developmental delay.
